g.text: Master requests register addresses; Slave measures DHT11 / HC-SR04 and serves SPI, FND, UART and LED outputs

g.desc: Master requests register addresses; Slave measures DHT11 / HC-SR04 and serves SPI, FND, UART and LED outputs

g.text: COMMON GND — MASTER BASYS3 + SLAVE BASYS3 + DHT11 + HC-SR04 + UART EQUIPMENT

g.desc: COMMON GND — MASTER BASYS3 + SLAVE BASYS3 + DHT11 + HC-SR04 + UART EQUIPMENT

g.text: Mode 0 | MSB first | SCK 1 MHz | 16 clocks

g.desc: Mode 0 | MSB first | SCK 1 MHz | 16 clocks

g.text: 2. Connect GND between both boards before SPI signals.

g.desc: 2. Connect GND between both boards before SPI signals.

g.text: 3. SPI and DHT11 use 3.3 V logic.

g.desc: 3. SPI and DHT11 use 3.3 V logic.

g.text: 4. HC-SR04 uses 5 V power; ECHO is normally 5 V.

g.desc: 4. HC-SR04 uses 5 V power; ECHO is normally 5 V.

g.text: Implementation and package pins: TBD in Master project

g.desc: Implementation and package pins: TBD in Master project

g.text: 5. Never connect HC-SR04 ECHO directly to Basys3.

g.desc: 5. Never connect HC-SR04 ECHO directly to Basys3.

g.text: 6. Keep SCK/MOSI/MISO/CS_n short and route with GND.

g.desc: 6. Keep SCK/MOSI/MISO/CS_n short and route with GND.

g.text: 1. Power each Basys3 from its own USB source.

g.desc: 1. Power each Basys3 from its own USB source.
